All 92 local constituencies have common IDs, normalized names and seat magnitudes across 2011, 2016 and 2021.
Frozen temporal hindcast selects persistence-first for both vote composition and turnout over the preregistered alternative family.
F-1 is an immutable, non-agentic structural prior based on 50,000 coherent elections over all 395 seats, registered with recomputed artifact hashes.
